# Polaris Documentation

---

Polaris is a protocol built around pETH, a yield-bearing reserve asset that collateralizes decentralized stablecoins and synthetic assets. It introduces a monetary system where collateral and protocol activity reinforce one another through entirely onchain mechanisms.
